info.name: Walton Plaza Product API
info.description: Postman collection for testing the Walton Plaza getProducts GraphQL API.

request.description: Fetches product details by UID. Set uid to null and use posItemCode to search by POS code.
Fetches the catalog page by page. isActive: null includes products regardless of active status. Increase skip by limit for subsequent pages.

exec: pm.test('Response contains a product list', function () { pm.expect(result.result.products).to.be.an('array'); });
